audit_metadata.scope: Complete system review - 225 source files, 16000+ LOC, 255 test files, 7 security vectors
audit_metadata.methodology: Multi-agent deep dive: code-review (xhigh) + pattern analysis + vulnerability assessment + test verification

executive_summary.recommendation: DO NOT DEPLOY — Fix blockers first

findings.title: 100% Parameterized Queries
findings.description: All database operations use parameterized queries via Supabase ORM
findings.evidence: Zero string concatenation in SQL queries (grep verified)

findings.title: Comprehensive Input Validation
findings.description: 47 Zod schemas covering all input vectors

findings.title: No Command Injection Patterns
findings.description: No shell execution, child_process calls, or command building detected

findings.title: No Dangerous HTML Patterns
findings.description: Zero dangerouslySetInnerHTML, eval(), or Function() constructor usage

findings.title: SafeStringSchema XSS Whitelist
findings.description: Blocks 15+ known XSS patterns: <script>, javascript:, data:, onclick, onerror, iframe

findings.title: Security Headers Ready
findings.description: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, CSP support

3_csrf_protection.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Protection
3_csrf_protection.critical_issue: Test coverage unverified — 364 failing tests prevent verification

findings.title: Double-Submit Cookie Pattern
findings.description: Properly implemented token generation, validation, and cookie management

findings.title: Timing-Safe Comparison
findings.description: Uses crypto.timingSafeEqual() to prevent timing attacks

findings.title: Secure Token Attributes
findings.description: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=strict, 1-hour expiry, path=/

findings.title: Origin Validation
findings.description: Exact-match origin checking (prevents origin spoofing)

findings.title: Unverified CSRF Coverage
findings.description: 364 failing tests prevent verification that CSRF middleware applies to ALL state-changing routes

findings.title: JWT RS256 Algorithm
findings.description: Asymmetric encryption, stronger than HS256

findings.title: Proper Token Lifecycle
findings.description: 24-hour access tokens, 7-day refresh tokens

findings.title: Role-Based Access Control
findings.description: 8 roles: admin, user, viewer, agent, service, observer, moderator, superadmin

findings.title: Protected Route Enforcement
findings.description: 7 protected API routes enforced at middleware level

findings.title: HTTPS Enforcement
findings.description: Production mode requires HTTPS

findings.title: Zero Hardcoded Secrets
findings.description: No API keys, passwords, or tokens in source code

findings.title: 25+ Sensitive Fields Redacted
findings.description: password, token, secret, api_key, etc. automatically redacted to [REDACTED] in logs

findings.title: Error Message Sanitization
findings.description: Stack traces never included in API responses

findings.title: Correlation IDs for Tracing
findings.description: Request tracking without PII exposure
findings.evidence: Enables debugging without leaking sensitive data

findings.title: .env Configuration
findings.description: .env properly .gitignored, .env.example provided

findings.title: 256-Bit Random Tokens
findings.description: CSRF tokens generated with crypto.randomBytes(32) = 256-bit entropy

findings.title: Timing-Safe Operations
findings.description: crypto.timingSafeEqual() prevents timing attacks

findings.title: UUID Generation
findings.description: crypto.randomUUID() with error handling

findings.title: Strong Algorithms Only
findings.description: RS256 for JWT, bcrypt for passwords, no MD5/SHA1/DES

findings.title: Per-IP Rate Limiting
findings.description: Correctly tracks requests per IP address

findings.title: Configurable Limits
findings.description: Default 100 requests per 60 seconds, customizable

findings.title: In-Memory Storage Not Production-Ready
findings.description: Rate limit state lost on server restart, doesn't work with load balancers

findings.title: 5 Redundant Implementations
findings.description: Code duplication across 5 files, inconsistent behavior

findings.title: Tests Failing
findings.description: 364 tests failing prevents verification of rate limiting behavior

critical_blockers.title: 364 Failing Tests
critical_blockers.impact: Cannot verify security behavior in real scenarios

critical_blockers.title: Rate Limiting Architecture
critical_blockers.problem: In-memory storage doesn't work with load balancers
critical_blockers.impact: Cannot scale, rate limits reset on restart

all_inputs_validated.requirement: All user inputs validated before processing
all_inputs_validated.evidence: 47 Zod schemas covering all input vectors

sql_injection_prevention.requirement: No string concatenation in SQL queries

csrf_protection_enabled.requirement: CSRF token validation on state-changing requests
